paragraphs.text: Wherefore, my brethren beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my beloved.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι, χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου, οὕτως στήκετε ἐν κυρίῳ, ἀγαπητοί.
paragraphs.translit: hōste, adelphoi mou agapētoi kai epipothētoi, chara kai stephanos mou, houtōs stēkete en kyriō, agapētoi.

paragraphs.text: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: Εὐοδίαν παρακαλῶ καὶ Συντύχην παρακαλῶ τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: Euodian parakalō kai Syntychēn parakalō to auto phronein en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Yea, I beseech thee also, true yokefellow, help these women, for they labored with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
paragraphs.original: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ, γνήσιε σύζυγε, συλλαμβάνου αὐταῖς, αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνεργῶν μου, ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς.
paragraphs.translit: nai erōtō kai se, gnēsie syzyge, syllambanou autais, haitines en tō euangeliō synēthlēsan moi meta kai Klēmentos kai tōn loipōn synergōn mou, hōn ta onomata en biblō zōēs.

paragraphs.text: Rejoice in the Lord always: again I will say, Rejoice.
paragraphs.original: Χαίρετε ἐν κυρίῳ πάντοτε· πάλιν ἐρῶ, χαίρετε.
paragraphs.translit: Chairete en kyriō pantote· palin erō, chairete.

paragraphs.text: Let your forbearance be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
paragraphs.original: τὸ ἐπιεικὲς ὑμῶν γνωσθήτω πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις. ὁ κύριος ἐγγύς·
paragraphs.translit: to epieikes hymōn gnōsthētō pasin anthrōpois. ho kyrios engys·

paragraphs.text: In nothing be anxious; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
paragraphs.original: μηδὲν μεριμνᾶτε, ἀλλʼ ἐν παντὶ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ δεήσει μετʼ εὐχαριστίας τὰ αἰτήματα ὑμῶν γνωριζέσθω πρὸς τὸν θεόν·
paragraphs.translit: mēden merimnate, allʼ en panti tē proseuchē kai tē deēsei metʼ eucharistias ta aitēmata hymōn gnōrizesthō pros ton theon·

paragraphs.text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ ὑπερέχουσα πάντα νοῦν φρουρήσει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ νοήματα ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hē eirēnē tou theou hē hyperechousa panta noun phrourēsei tas kardias hymōn kai ta noēmata hymōn en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honorable, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
paragraphs.original: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, ὅσα ἐστὶν ἀληθῆ, ὅσα σεμνά, ὅσα δίκαια, ὅσα ἁγνά, ὅσα προσφιλῆ, ὅσα εὔφημα, εἴ τις ἀρετὴ καὶ εἴ τις ἔπαινος, ταῦτα λογίζεσθε·
paragraphs.translit: To loipon, adelphoi, hosa estin alēthē, hosa semna, hosa dikaia, hosa hagna, hosa prosphilē, hosa euphēma, ei tis aretē kai ei tis epainos, tauta logizesthe·

paragraphs.text: The things which ye both learned and received and heard and saw in me, these things do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
paragraphs.original: ἃ καὶ ἐμάθετε καὶ παρελάβετε καὶ ἠκούσατε καὶ εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοί, ταῦτα πράσσετε· καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ha kai emathete kai parelabete kai ēkousate kai eidete en emoi, tauta prassete· kai ho theos tēs eirēnēs estai methʼ hymōn.

paragraphs.text: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length ye have revived your thought for me; wherein ye did indeed take thought, but ye lacked opportunity.
paragraphs.original: Ἐχάρην δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ μεγάλως ὅτι ἤδη ποτὲ ἀνεθάλετε τὸ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ φρονεῖν, ἐφʼ ᾧ καὶ ἐφρονεῖτε ἠκαιρεῖσθε δέ.
paragraphs.translit: Echarēn de en kyriō megalōs hoti ēdē pote anethalete to hyper emou phronein, ephʼ hō kai ephroneite ēkaireisthe de.

paragraphs.text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therein to be content.
paragraphs.original: οὐχ ὅτι καθʼ ὑστέρησιν λέγω, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔμαθον ἐν οἷς εἰμι αὐτάρκης εἶναι·
paragraphs.translit: ouch hoti kathʼ hysterēsin legō, egō gar emathon en hois eimi autarkēs einai·

paragraphs.text: I know how to be abased, and I know also how to abound: in everything and in all things have I learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in want.
paragraphs.original: οἶδα καὶ ταπεινοῦσθαι, οἶδα καὶ περισσεύειν· ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι, καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν, καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι·
paragraphs.translit: oida kai tapeinousthai, oida kai perisseuein· en panti kai en pasin memyēmai, kai chortazesthai kai peinan, kai perisseuein kai hystereisthai·

paragraphs.text: I can do all things in him that strengtheneth me.
paragraphs.original: πάντα ἰσχύω ἐν τῷ ἐνδυναμοῦντί με.
paragraphs.translit: panta ischyō en tō endynamounti me.

paragraphs.text: Howbeit ye did well that ye had fellowship with my affliction.
paragraphs.original: πλὴν καλῶς ἐποιήσατε συγκοινωνήσαντές μου τῇ θλίψει.
paragraphs.translit: plēn kalōs epoiēsate synkoinōnēsantes mou tē thlipsei.

paragraphs.text: And ye yourselves also know, ye Philippians, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church had fellowship with me in the matter of giving and receiving but ye only;
paragraphs.original: Οἴδατε δὲ καὶ ὑμεῖς, Φιλιππήσιοι, ὅτι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, ὅτε ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας, οὐδεμία μοι ἐκκλησία ἐκοινώνησεν εἰς λόγον δόσεως καὶ λήμψεως εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς μόνοι,
paragraphs.translit: Oidate de kai hymeis, Philippēsioi, hoti en archē tou euangeliou, hote exēlthon apo Makedonias, oudemia moi ekklēsia ekoinōnēsen eis logon doseōs kai lēmpseōs ei mē hymeis monoi,

paragraphs.text: for even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my need.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς εἰς τὴν χρείαν μοι ἐπέμψατε.
paragraphs.translit: hoti kai en Thessalonikē kai hapax kai dis eis tēn chreian moi epempsate.

paragraphs.text: Not that I seek for the gift; but I seek for the fruit that increaseth to your account.
paragraphs.original: οὐχ ὅτι ἐπιζητῶ τὸ δόμα, ἀλλὰ ἐπιζητῶ τὸν καρπὸν τὸν πλεονάζοντα εἰς λόγον ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ouch hoti epizētō to doma, alla epizētō ton karpon ton pleonazonta eis logon hymōn.

paragraphs.text: But I have all things, and abound: I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things [that came] from you, and odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God.
paragraphs.original: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω· πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρʼ ὑμῶν, ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, θυσίαν δεκτήν, εὐάρεστον τῷ θεῷ.
paragraphs.translit: apechō de panta kai perisseuō· peplērōmai dexamenos para Epaphroditou ta parʼ hymōn, osmēn euōdias, thysian dektēn, euareston tō theō.

paragraphs.text: And my God shall supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεός μου πληρώσει πᾶσαν χρείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos mou plērōsei pasan chreian hymōn kata to ploutos autou en doxē en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: Now unto our God and Father [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: τῷ δὲ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ ἡμῶν ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: tō de theō kai patri hēmōn hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren that are with me salute you.
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντα ἅγιον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ ἀδελφοί.
paragraphs.translit: Aspasasthe panta hagion en Christō Iēsou. aspazontai hymas hoi syn emoi adelphoi.

paragraphs.text: All the saints salute you, especially they that are of Caesar`s household.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι, μάλιστα δὲ οἱ ἐκ τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας.
paragraphs.translit: aspazontai hymas pantes hoi hagioi, malista de hoi ek tēs Kaisaros oikias.

paragraphs.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis tou kyriou Iēsou Christou meta tou pneumatos hymōn.
